##### Fall 2026

## Notice for Engineering Technology Program Candidates

Candidates who wish to apply for Freezing or Downgrading their admission are requested to submit their applications through the Admission Portal by *August 21, 2026 Friday, 11:59 AM*. Please note that applications submitted after the deadline will not be entertained..

## The Undergraduate Admissions 2026 *Third merit list for Engineering and Computer Sc Program* has been uploaded to the Admission Portal on *August 13, 2026*. Applicants are advised to log in to their accounts to view their admission status and the offered program.

---

## The Undergraduate Admissions 2026 *First merit list for Engineering Technology Programs* has been uploaded to the Admission Portal on *August 7, 2026*. Applicants are advised to log in to their accounts to view their admission status and the offered program.

---

## Notice for Engineering Program & Computer Sc. Program Candidates

Candidates who wish to apply for Freezing or Downgrading of their admission are requested to send an email to **ug.admission@uettaxila.edu.pk** using their registered email address (the email address used on the Admission Portal).
Please use the following subject line: "**Application for Downgrading/Freezing**"
In the body of the email, kindly mention your Admission Tracking ID along with your request.
Your email must be sent no later than *August 11, 2026 Tuesday, 11:59 PM*. Requests received after the deadline may not be considered.
